# BUILDER_PROVENANCE — github

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Builder version | @hiai-gg/agent-plugin-builder **0.0.6** |
| Builder command | `bunx @hiai-gg/agent-plugin-builder create --config plugin.yml --output plugins/github` |
| Config file | `plugin.yml` (declarative source of truth) |
| Skill source files | `skills-src/github/*.md` (bodies via `body-file`) |

## Files generated by Builder

- `plugin.json` — full manifest (name, version 0.0.1, author, homepage,
  repository, license, keywords)
- `mcp.json` — named server `github`, streamable-http
- `skills/review-pull-request/SKILL.md`
- `skills/triage-issue/SKILL.md`
- `skills/investigate-ci/SKILL.md`
- `skills/explore-repository/SKILL.md`
- `README.md` (scaffold)

## Manual edits after generation

| File | Edit | Type |
|---|---|---|
| `README.md` | Replaced Builder scaffold with full public README (what/why/auth/read-only/clients/limitations) | Content |
| `LICENSE` | Created (MIT, HiAI) — Builder does not generate LICENSE | Content |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | Created (0.0.1) — Builder does not generate CHANGELOG | Content |
| `docs/BUILD_NOTES.md`, `docs/UPSTREAM_TRUST.md`, `docs/BUILDER_PROVENANCE.md` | Created per release requirements | Content |

**Manual structural edits: NONE** — the generated structure (plugin.json,
mcp.json, skills/) was used as-is. Skill bodies were authored as domain content,
not structural edits.

## Builder issues encountered

1. `create --config` with `--force` on a non-empty output directory throws
   "Output directory is not empty" and **ignores `--force`** — the directory
   had to be removed first. (Builder issue; recorded.)
2. Builder's generated README is a minimal scaffold (contents/skills/MCP list)
   and does not meet the public README standard — replaced with a full README.
3. Builder generates **no LICENSE and no CHANGELOG** — both created manually.
